label: Alarm
depicts: Round alarm clock with two floating bells and short hands inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simpler round alarm clock without feet at the bottom.
avoid_when: Do not use for the twin bell clock with bottom feet when that more classic silhouette is needed.

label: Album
depicts: Round record disc with one centered dot and one upper groove
use_when: Use when the interface wants a round record style disc rather than a sleeve or folder shape.
avoid_when: Do not use for the open album sleeve when the main shape should be a wide pocket.

label: Album
depicts: Open record sleeve with a flat top edge and wide pocket opening
use_when: Use when the interface wants a record sleeve or open pocket shape rather than a round disc.
avoid_when: Do not use for the round record disc when the icon should stay circular.

label: Android
depicts: Robot head and body with two antennae inside a rounded shell
use_when: Use when the interface wants the full android robot with body, eyes, and antennae.
avoid_when: Do not use for the half head android when the lower body should not be visible.

label: Android
depicts: Half android head with two antennae and a flat lower edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants only the android head cap without the full body below it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the full android robot when a rounded lower body should remain visible.
